records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Nora,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Cedar Logistics set up
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for setting up Cedar Logistics on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Nora explicitly said they're still deciding and asked for another week [email:358b3bb8], signalling low near-term intent. No project created at day 6 despite three touches [email:7c101210, email:493b6690, email:5b15b29d]; only 1 invite, 0 tickets, starter plan. Some chance evaluation includes real use within 8 days.

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield — how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for the straight answer — totally fair to take another week to decide, and I won't crowd you in the meantime.

One thing that often makes the evaluation clearer: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so putting one real project in with your teammate tends to show whether it fits Cedar Logistics better than anything I can say.

If it would help, I'm happy to set up a short call this week to talk through what you're weighing — otherwise I'll check back after your week is up.

Best,
Priya
